# Saffron of Kashmir

> Premium Kashmiri Mongra saffron, harvested in Pampore, Kashmir.

## Pages

- [Home](https://saffronofkashmir.com/): Products, ordering information, FAQ, and the brand story.
- [Products](https://saffronofkashmir.com/products): Full product catalogue. In stock: Royal Mongra 2g, Collector's Tin 5g and Heritage Reserve 10g. Out of stock: Kashmiri Kahwa Blend 100g. Coming soon: Saffron Honey 500ml and Saffron Oil 15ml.
- [Recipes](https://saffronofkashmir.com/recipes): Tested saffron recipes: Kashmiri Kahwa, Zafrani Pulao, Kesar Doodh and Arabic Saffron Machboos.
- [Blog](https://saffronofkashmir.com/blogs): Guides: What is Mongra Grade Saffron and Why It Matters, The Saffron Fields of Pampore: A Centuries-Old Legacy, How to Test Saffron Purity at Home (3 Methods), Using Kashmiri Saffron in Arabic Cuisine, Kashmir Saffron GI No. 635: What It Actually Means, How to Read a Saffron Lab Report, Why Most "Kashmiri Saffron" Sold Online Is Not From Kashmir, Nobody Agrees How Much Saffron Kashmir Produces, Five Things Sold as Saffron That Are Not Saffron, What Saffron Should Cost in 2026, Mongra, Lacha, Zarda, Super Negin: The Grade Names Decoded, How to Store Saffron So It Is Still Worth What You Paid, How Much Saffron to Actually Use and Harvest Diary: This Season in Our Fields.
